title: pdp_cheby
description: `pdp_cheby` approximates a mapping function over the range −1 to 1 using Chebyshev coefficients. Its creation argument sets the order—and therefore the number of coefficients to order + 1—with a minimum default order of 2; coefficients can be set individually with `coef` messages or cleared with `reset`, while the right inlet sets the number of iterations.
